shots.title: Golden hour at the pool
shots.tip: Last hour before sunset. Stand at the far end so the clubhouse and palms fit. Keep residents out of the frame.

shots.title: Cozy by the fireplace
shots.tip: Fireplace on, lamps warm, overhead lights off. Get low and shoot across the sofas.

shots.title: Stone wall lounge
shots.tip: A mug and a book on the table. Shoot from the doorway at chest height.

shots.title: Café coffee moment
shots.tip: A latte on the counter with the pendants glowing behind it.

shots.title: Morning workout
shots.tip: Early light, equipment in focus. A 5 second slow pan makes a great reel.

shots.title: Work from home, done right
shots.tip: Laptop open, coffee beside it. Hands only is perfect.

shots.title: Model home, holiday ready
shots.tip: Throw blanket, a flameless candle, a small tree. Stand in the doorway, phone at chest height.

shots.title: Kitchen details
shots.tip: Close ups sell: the counters, the beams, a bowl of fruit.

shots.title: Stillwater Lakes from above
shots.tip: Only our own photos from above. On the ground, shoot the pond and buildings at golden hour.
